svg.title: EngineCore preparation and GPU memory
svg.desc: EngineCore prepares the model, the KV cache and the scheduler in order. init_device sets the memory budget as total memory times gpu_memory_utilization. load_model fills it with weights. profile_run measures the activation peak and profile_cudagraph_memory estimates CUDA graph memory. The remainder of the budget becomes the KV cache, which initialize_from_config allocates. compile_or_warm_up_model then captures the CUDA graphs. The scheduler gets the number of KV blocks and needs no new GPU memory.

g.text: GETS NUM_GPU_BLOCKS · NO NEW GPU MEMORY
THEN SEND READY AND ENTER RUN_BUSY_LOOP()
